chunks: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم stood at Jamʿ, and the people began rushing toward the place of the hooves of his she-camel. So he gestured with his hand while standing and said: “Indeed, I have stood here, and all of this is a place of standing.”

key_terms.بِجَمْعٍ: at Jamʿ, meaning Muzdalifah, the ritual station of standing during hajj
key_terms.مَوْقِفٌ: a valid place of standing for the rite
key_terms.يَبْتَدِرُونَ: they were rushing quickly to reach first

ai.seo_question: Does standing at only the exact spot of the Prophet’s camel in Jamʿ count, or is the whole area a valid mawqif?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم stood at Jamʿ, people hurried toward the exact place where his camel stood, seeking to imitate that spot. He clarified by gesture and statement that the entire designated area is a valid mawqif, indicating ease and breadth in the rite.
